content: We need to build complete retrosynthesis route. The target molecule is the big sulfonamide (the first SMILES). The steps: we have template 214705 (sulfonamide formation). The precursors from apply_template-1 gave two SMILES: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1" and "O=S(=O)(O)c1ccccc1F". However verification failed because template expects maybe O=S(=O)(Cl) not O=S(=O)(O). The original reaction described: aromatic amine attacks electrophilic sulfur of phenylsulfonyl chloride, then collapse expels Cl- and base deprotonates. So the sulfonyl chloride is O=S(=O)(Cl)Ar. Our precursor should be phenylsulfonyl chloride with F substituent: O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F. The apply_template gave O=S(=O)(O)c1ccccc1F (sulfonic acid). So we need correct precursor: O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F. Let's verify with that.
